project_resources_payload_check.name: project_resources_payload_check
project_resources_payload_check.value:
(
        ("project_resources"."type" = 'link' and "project_resources"."url" is not null and "project_resources"."content" is null)
        or
        ("project_resources"."type" = 'document_brief' and "project_resources"."url" is null)
      )

task_resources_payload_check.name: task_resources_payload_check
task_resources_payload_check.value:
(
        (
          "task_resources"."type" = 'link'
          and "task_resources"."url" is not null
          and "task_resources"."content" is null
        )
        or
        (
          "task_resources"."type" = 'document_brief'
          and "task_resources"."url" is null
        )
      )

workspace_discord_integrations_category_.name: workspace_discord_integrations_category_requires_guild_check
workspace_discord_integrations_category_.value:
"workspace_discord_integrations"."project_category_id" is null
          or
          "workspace_discord_integrations"."guild_id" is not null
